messages:
marta: Noticed a jump in validation rejects on action-bridge last night ~21:12 UTC. Primary error: "expected object but got array" for tool responses. route=action-bridge strict_validate=true reject_rate=6.8% (baseline ~0.3%).

ben: Did we change validators recently?

marta: Kai flipped stricter schema validation to true for a canary slice last week. Most failed calls appear to come from a client adapter that returns [] when there's no items instead of {}.

kai: That's my canary change. I wanted to catch malformed shapes early. Looks like some adapters interpret empty result as an array. I can roll the canary back.

sarah: Quick Q: do rejected invocations count against quotas/billing? We're surfacing a lot of failures to customers and still recording usage.

marta: Yes, rejected calls currently increment request and token usage exports. Billing is counting them. There's an open billing ticket but no fix yet.

ben: Important tradeoff: silent coercion reduces user errors but masks bugs. If we introduce automatic coercion, it must be auditable and opt-in.

kai: Proposed immediate mitigation: set strict_schema=false for the canary slice to stop customer errors. For medium term: add a reject_reason tag to telemetry, sample failing payloads, and add an account-level toggle for permissive coercions.

sarah: Console UX thought: the current "rejects" metric mixes validation with policy/permission failures. We should add a Fncall Validation panel that breaks down reasons and surfaces sampled redacted payloads plus remediation tips.

marta: I like an automated fallback policy for nonfatal patterns (empty array -> coerce to {} with annotation coerced_by=platform), but only if the customer opts in or for internal testing orgs by default. Also add a grace window when enabling strict mode so customers get warnings before enforcement.

ben: Suggestion: add a configurable enforcement_delay: 0m/1h/6h/24h when flipping strict mode. During the delay, show warnings and sample rejects rather than hard failures.

ops-bot: alert: schema-rejects-action-bridge created -> https://console/reports/abcd :warning:

kai: I'll open a PR that: (1) adds reject_reason tag; (2) wires sampled_payloads into a redacted store; (3) implements account flag coerce_exceptions; (4) exposes a canary rollback endpoint. Tagging @marta for review. I'll roll back the canary now.

sarah: UX ticket PLT-789 filed for validation panel + enforcement slider. Add remediation copy: e.g. "Return {} instead of [] for empty results" and include one-click sample payload view.

marta: Telemetry action items: reject_count by reason, sampled_payloads cap 50/day per route, fallback_success_rate, billing_after_fallback. Ben to own billing export changes so we can decide non-billable policy for quick fallbacks.

ben: Also split error_budget calc so 5xx and validation_rejects are separate. Right now they hide the root cause.

kai: Rolling rollback now to unbreak prod. Will follow-up with PR and a small config draft for discussion.

marta: Config sketch for product/console teams:

```yaml
validation:
  mode: strict # soft | strict
  enforcement_delay: 24h
  allowed_coercions:
    - empty_array_to_object
    - missing_optional_nullify
  sample_rate: 0.05
```

marta: Follow-ups: kai PR, PLT-789, billing ticket assign to ben. Closing thread.
